title: International transfers and SWIFT - explained
content: Cross-border transfers can involve sending, intermediary and receiving institutions, exchange conversion and compliance checks. A SWIFT identifier helps identify an institution; it does not itself establish the correct beneficiary account or guarantee final credit.
